final: SELECT ArtistId, album_count, share, share - average_share AS difference FROM (SELECT ArtistId, album_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM (SELECT ArtistId, album_count, album_count * 1.0 / SUM(album_count) OVER () AS share FROM (SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId))) ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
